metadata.description: Pragmatic multi-agent orchestration: independent review and steerable delegation across Codex, Claude Code, OpenCode, Grok Build, Gemini, Devin CLI, and Antigravity CLI — for any agent that supports the Agent Skills standard.

plugins.name: pragmatic-orchestration
plugins.description: Multi-agent orchestration for coding agents: run external agent CLIs (Codex, Claude Code, OpenCode, Grok Build, Gemini, Devin CLI, Antigravity CLI) as independent reviewers, stateful repository researchers, steerable single-agent implementers, or media workers (audio/video transcription, image generation and editing) via the `porch` CLI. Also ships coordinator-mode (a long-lived coordinating role that delegates implementation and keeps a journal across compaction) and remote-agents: dedicated remote Linux/Windows agent hosts (SSH-over-SSM, headless desktop, work bridge).
